title: Unified Agent Contract (UAC) v0.2.0
description: Standard definition for Charm Agents, focusing on Interface Protocol, Runtime Adapter configuration, and Dependency Injection.

persona.description: Identity and metadata for Store display and Search

goals.description: Semantic goals for planning and evaluation

interface.description: The USB Protocol: Defines Inputs, Outputs, and State structure for interoperability.

input.description: JSON Schema defining valid input arguments

output.description: JSON Schema defining standard output format

state.description: Schema of the persistent state. Required for Runtime to perform snapshot/resume.

runtime.description: Configuration for the Charm Runtime Adapter and Dependency Injection.

adapter.description: How to load and wrap the underlying agent.

entry_point.description: Path to the agent object. e.g., 'src.my_agent:crew_instance'

environment_variables.description: Required env vars (keys only) that Runtime must ensure exist.

injections.description: Resources the agent expects the Runtime to inject.

llm_client.description: If true, Runtime injects a configured LLM client (standardized auth).

tools.description: List of standard Charm Tools (IDs) to be injected. e.g. ['google-search', 'stripe-payment']

memory_store.description: If true, Runtime injects a connection to the Charm Vector Store.

policies.description: Governance rules enforced by the Runtime Wrapper.

workflow.description: (Optional) Descriptive graph for observability. Not used for execution in Wrapper mode.
